access.note_title: Pages added to / removed from this member's role
access.heading: Page access
access.lead: Choose which pages this staff member can open, on top of what their role gives.
access.legend: Role default follows the role (✓ given / ✕ not given). Allow adds the page, Deny hides it and blocks it.
access.reset_confirm: Remove every page setting of {name}? They will see exactly what their role gives.
access.locked_owner: The owner always has access to every page. Their access can't be restricted.
access.locked_self: You can't change your own page access. Ask the clinic owner.
access.not_yours: you can't open this page yourself
access.takes_effect: Changes apply immediately, on the member's next page load.
access.blocked_title: You don't have access to this page
access.blocked_text: The clinic administration has not given you access to “{page}”. If you need it, ask the clinic owner or manager.
access.role_only_text: These pages open only with a role that includes them (clinic administration and settings). Change the member's role in the team list if they need them.

errors_access.PAGE_ACCESS_DENIED: You don't have access to this page.
errors_access.ACCESS_OWNER: The owner always has access to every page.
errors_access.ACCESS_SELF: You can't change your own page access.
errors_access.ACCESS_CORE: This page is needed to use DocBook and is always available.
errors_access.ACCESS_ROLE_ONLY: This page is given through the role only.
errors_access.ACCESS_BEYOND_OWN: You can only give access to pages you can open yourself.
